title: spawn_blocking for all LMDB operations is the correct async/sync bridge pattern
description: Both LmdbBlockStore and LmdbStore dispatch all LMDB calls via tokio::task::spawn_blocking. LMDB is synchronous and can block on write transaction serialization. Running it on the async runtime thread pool would stall other futures sharing the same thread. A contributor might suggest using an async-native LMDB wrapper. Don't change this without profiling: spawn_blocking overhead is negligible compared to LMDB write latency, and the pattern is correct and explicit.
